svg.aria-label: Linear sources feed the scene shaders, which write linear values to the R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT scene target. The composite pass clamps and encodes linear to sRGB into the B8G8R8A8_UNORM swapchain, which ImGui's already-sRGB colors also reach directly, and the swapchain goes to the display.
